name: Relay module (1 channel, 5 V, optocoupled)
description: Switches a separate load (pump, lamp, motor, up to 10 A at 30 V DC) with a 5 V relay. Control side: VCC → 5V, GND → GND, IN → a GPIO. Load side: COM and NO in series with the load and its own supply (NO closes when the relay clicks; NC opens). Most modules are active-LOW: digitalWrite(pin, LOW) switches it on (prop trigger).

pins.label: VCC
pins.description: 5 V for the relay coil (~70 mA). Not 3.3 V: the coil needs at least 3.75 V to pull in.

pins.label: IN
pins.description: Control input. Active low (default): LOW = relay on, HIGH or 5 V = off. About 3 mA flows while on.

pins.label: NO
pins.description: Normally open contact: connected to COM while the relay is on. Usual choice for a load.

pins.label: NC
pins.description: Normally closed contact: connected to COM while the relay is off.

props.label: Trigger level

options.label: Active low (LOW = on), most optocoupled modules
Active high (HIGH = on), transistor modules / H jumper

props.description: Which IN level turns the relay on. Check the module's silkscreen or the H/L jumper.

footprint: 50 × 26 mm module, 3-pin 0.1 in header (VCC GND IN), 3-way 5 mm screw terminal (NO COM NC)

bindings.description: The coil is on and COM is switched to NO.
SVG transform of the switch arm.
